out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. OBSERVED THE INSTALLATION OF NEW PIZZA OVEN IN UNDER EXHAUST HOOD IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: RENOVATION AMENDMENT WITH SPECIFICATIONS FOR NEW EQUIPMENT INTO PLUS ACCOUNT FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT WITHIN 10 DAYS. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USE OF EQUIPMENT UNTIL APPROVED BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PREPARING LIMES TO BE USED AT THE BAR WITHOUT GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AND DON GLOVES BEFORE RESUMING PREPARING OF LIMES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES CONTINUED TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: OBSERVED NO PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER WAS AVAILABLE FOR SALMON WHICH MAY BE OFFERED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW AS PER MENU.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REQUEST PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM SUPPLIER WITHIN 10 DAYS. EMAIL EHS ONCE LETTER HAS BEEN OBTAINED.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED FROZEN REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED (ROP) SALMON THAWING IN SEALED PACKAGING IN DELFIELD 2 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC OPENED PACKAGING DURING INSPECTION AND RETURNED SALMON TO UNIT TO CONTINUE THAWING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink: NON SMOKING AND SMOKING BARS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP FOR EACH STATION DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: SODA DISPENSER NOZZLES.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLES STORED ON SHELVING WITH CLEAN UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION . PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, LIQUIDS NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at NON-SMOKING BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC SUPPLIED HAND SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. BAKED POTATOES AT 55F PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD POTATOES DURING INSPECTION. CROSSROADS (Inspection Date: 07/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: BAKED POTATOES AT 55F COOKED THE PREVIOUS DAY STACKED ON TRAY; COOKED CHICKEN WINGS AT 43-52F BAGGED AND STACKED IN DEEP CONTAINERS WALKING IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD BAKED POTATOES; AND ATO PLACED WINGS ON TRAY TO COOL IN REFRIGERATOR TO 41 F BEFORE TRANSFERRING TO BAGS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE AND SIDE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR..
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL INNER DOOR SWEEP AND SIDE SEALS ON BACK KITCHEN DOOR.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: OBSERVED WATER USED IN PIZZA DOUGH PREPARATION IN NON FOOD GRADE SPRAY BOTTLE ON DELFIELD 2 DOOR PREP TOP (PIZZA STATION).
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD BOTTLE DURING INSPECTION AND USE ONLY FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS FOR FOOD STORAGE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW BEEF STORED OVER COOKED WINGS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION. PIC PROVIDED TRAINING ON RAW FOODS ORGANIZATION TO EMPLOYEE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system AT CHEMICAL SYSTEM CONNECTED AT MOP SINK FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE EMAIL EHS WITH EVIDENCE OF INSTALLATION WITHIN 3 DAYS.
